---
name: Evaluation case
about: A query that Pagelens gets wrong, with what a right answer looks like
labels: evaluation
---

## Query

Text and, if any, a description of the reference image.

## Evidence policy

`visual` (the object must be depicted) or `any` (text counts too).

## Expected

Pages that must be found, as `file.pdf:page` (one-based).

## Must not be confirmed

Pages that look relevant but are not.

## Fixture

Use a fictional or public document. Never attach customer PDFs.
